en.text:
Hits against Barrier Champions, Subjugator <link Bosses [#CombatantClassifications] />, or non-matching Elemental Shields deal increasingly higher damage.

Buff is removed upon hitting a matching shield or an unshielded enemy.

Damage increase by Weapon Archetype:
• Fusion Rifles: untested //#e${ * #d}% per hit, up to #e${ * #d}%
• Machine Guns, Auto/Pulse/Trace Rifles: #e${10 * #d}% per hit, up to #e${50 * #d}%
• Linear Fusion Rifles: #e${22 * #d}% per hit, up to #e${44 * #d}%
• Bows, Glaives, Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: #e${25 * #d}% per hit, up to #e${50 * #d}%

var d = 1.4
#e The damage buff is increased by ~40%.
